parameters.jsonBody:
={"contents":[{"parts":[{"text": {{ JSON.stringify("You write patient messages for " + ($json.clinic_name || "the clinic") + " in India. Warm, short, respectful Indian English. You must NOT diagnose, must NOT name any illness and must NOT suggest any medicine.

CLINIC PHONE: " + ($json.clinic_phone || "") + "
REVIEW LINK: " + ($json.review_link || "") + "

GROUP A, REMINDERS for appointments tomorrow " + ($json.tomorrow_date || "") + ":
" + ($json.reminder_lines || "none") + "

GROUP B, MISSED APPOINTMENTS that were never marked completed:
" + ($json.noshow_lines || "none") + "

GROUP C, FOLLOW UPS for patients seen yesterday " + ($json.yesterday_date || "") + ":
" + ($json.followup_lines || "none") + "

Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown fences. One key messages holding an array. Each entry has keys: appointment_id, type, subject, lines.
type is reminder, noshow or followup matching the group it came from.
subject is a short clear email subject that includes the clinic name.
lines is an array of 2 to 4 short sentences forming the message body.
For reminder: confirm the date, time and doctor name, ask them to arrive 10 minutes early, and ask them to carry previous reports and current medicines.
For noshow: be gentle and non blaming, say we missed them, and invite them to reply or call to rebook. Never imply fault.
For followup: ask warmly how they are feeling after the visit, remind them to complete any advised tests or follow the doctor guidance, and politely invite a Google review using the review link. Do NOT ask about specific symptoms and do NOT give any health advice.
If a group says none, produce no entries for that group.
No em-dashes anywhere.") }} }]}],"generationConfig":{"temperature":0.5,"maxOutputTokens":8192,"responseMimeType":"application/json"}}

={"contents":[{"parts":[{"text": {{ JSON.stringify("You are a clinic operations analyst writing the morning brief for the clinic owner in India. Be practical and factual. Do NOT give any medical advice.

DATE: " + ($json.run_date || "") + "
Appointments today: " + ($json.today_count || 0) + "
Urgent or emergency cases today: " + ($json.urgent_today || 0) + "
Reminders going out for tomorrow: " + ($json.reminder_count || 0) + "
Missed appointments needing rebooking: " + ($json.noshow_count || 0) + "
Follow ups going out today: " + ($json.followup_count || 0) + "
Messages skipped because they were already sent earlier: " + ($json.skipped_count || 0) + "
Total patient records: " + ($json.total_records || 0) + "

TODAY SCHEDULE:
" + ($json.today_lines || "none") + "

DOCTOR LOAD TODAY:
" + ($json.doctor_load_lines || "none") + "

MISSED APPOINTMENTS:
" + ($json.noshow_lines || "none") + "

Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown fences. Keys: headline, summary, actions, risk_note.
headline is one punchy line the owner reads first and must mention the most important number of the day.
summary is 2 to 3 sentences in plain Indian English covering how busy today is, the doctor load, and the recovery opportunity from missed appointments.
If there is nothing to do today, say so plainly and calmly rather than inventing work.
actions is an array of exactly 3 short imperative operational next steps for the front desk.
risk_note is one line on the biggest operational risk today.
No em-dashes anywhere.") }} }]}],"generationConfig":{"temperature":0.6,"maxOutputTokens":8192,"responseMimeType":"application/json"}}

parameters.subject: =Clinic Ops Brief {{ $("Ops Engine").first().json.run_date }} - {{ $("Ops Engine").first().json.today_count }} today, {{ $("Ops Engine").first().json.noshow_count }} to rebook
